Selected at runtime by a small factory
reading LLM_PROVIDER (deps.py) - ChatService
only ever depends on this interface, never
on a concrete provider.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
The single interception point for observability -
no logging call exists anywhere else in the codebase.
Instrumentation failures are swallowed here;
provider failures are always re-raised.
